title: manuscript-guard completed reporting checklist
description: Where each checklist item is addressed in this manuscript. Journals ask for this file at submission; producing it as a build artefact rather than the night before means the gaps surface while there is still time to fix them, which is the only reason a reporting checklist is worth anything.

where.description: Section, and page or heading, where the item is addressed. Checked against the manuscript's actual headings.

not_applicable.description: Why this item does not apply. A reason, not a tick: 'no interventions were assigned' rather than 'n/a'.
